meta.title: DSH Sync Tool
meta.description: Git-based synchronization for global DSH configurations across devices. Syncs MCAPs, skills, plugins, and agent presets. Sessions are NOT synced.

dsh-sync-status.description: Check git status, detect conflicts, and view sync health.
